pullRequests.title: fix(levels): Yeedil passes the object to func_L03_00326458
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: fix/l20-pass-object
pullRequests.body: Yeedil's func_L20_00310E38 called func_L03_00326458() with no argument, relying on the object still being in a0. It now passes the object, the same way Endako's calls do, and declares the argument. The output is byte-identical: tools/check.py reports 20_yeedil OK, 1 of 1 places. Without this, the PC port called the routine with a stray pointer and crashed on Yeedil.

pullRequests.title: fix(levels): Yeedil's spawner gets the link words through a pointer
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: fix/l20-spawner-pointer
pullRequests.body: func_L20_0039DCF8 passed a 12-byte struct by value as func_L02_002EF388's fourth argument. Every other caller passes a pointer there. The PS2 compiler passes a struct that size by a pointer to a copy, so the bytes matched; the PC port passed the words in registers instead and crashed on Yeedil. It now passes &arg and declares the parameter as a pointer. The output is byte-identical: tools/check.py reports 20_yeedil OK, 1 of 1 places.
